scope: Proposed bounded follow-ups, not active delegations, implementation claims or device authorization. Follow existing coordinator ownership and per-file provenance.

tasks.title: Extend source locks and the feature ledger
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid mixed source generations and repeated pending/already-integrated audits.
tasks.reuse: Existing provenance/stage manifests; extend the concurrent native-GPU source collector rather than creating another.
tasks.local_seam: Source receipts + release series + selected image manifests
tasks.first_proof: Wrong pin/hash, old UFS offset/mask fixture, absent adapter and host-runner exit0/GPU FAIL must be classified correctly.
tasks.limits: Source metadata is not physical acceptance.

tasks.title: Share one native GPU ABI profile
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid repeated manual firmware/context/MMU layout reconstruction.
tasks.reuse: MIT-side Volcanic DDK and existing firmware/VM/queue layout probes.
tasks.first_proof: Actual native adapters consume one generated profile and refuse deliberate size/offset/BVNC/DDK disagreement.
tasks.limits: Captured health FAIL remains STOP; matching ABI/real execution unproved.

tasks.title: Finish the current guarded sampler
tasks.work_avoided: Use already implemented optimization and original-output oracle.
tasks.reuse: Existing original NEON worker; libyuv single-axis row primitive only if profiling justifies it.
tasks.first_proof: Exact bytes, refusal/fallback/call coverage and emitted ARM64 implementation symbols; compare any narrow backend against actual original.
tasks.limits: No phone speed claim until a controlled coordinator-run profile.

tasks.title: Add a catalog/variant manifest adapter
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid writing another CAR/BOM parser and chasing filenames manually.
tasks.reuse: Pinned MIT ipsw metadata-only parser; BSD host CoreUI cross-check.
tasks.first_proof: Distinguish missing catalog/name/exact variant, unsupported layout and runtime lookup; use known visible, failing, canonical and nonexistent names.
tasks.limits: Modern layout/runtime fallback may differ; derived manifests stay ignored.

tasks.title: Finish display admission/drain, then reuse panel command helpers
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid reconstructing revision-aware brightness/idle DCS policy.
tasks.reuse: MIT panel/command/revision helpers; matching completion code as reference.
tasks.first_proof: Reference ownership survives refusal, timeout/late completion and stop; fake transport verifies revision selection, error and delay order.
tasks.limits: Keep current panel limits; physical completion/rate behavior separate.

tasks.title: Complete WLAN registry publication
tasks.work_avoided: Reuse a demonstrated Darwin discovery shape.
tasks.reuse: APSL2 HakiOS WLAN ancestry and observed-address publication.
tasks.first_proof: Host IOKit fixture checks correct ancestry, real wlan parent, byte-exact observed address and allocation/attach failure cleanup.
tasks.limits: Real ifnet/node/address required; runtime benefit unmeasured.

tasks.title: Add a station mailbox and scan snapshot converter
tasks.reuse: HakiOS station/Apple80211 boundary over existing BCM4390 IPC9 owner.
tasks.first_proof: Synthetic passive-scan records preserve bounded IEs; queue ordering, timeout/cancel, duplicate BSSID and malformed-length cases reach actual adapter.
tasks.limits: iOS26 request ABI, supported channels and real completion needed; no association in first task.

tasks.title: Prepare a Wave6 command inventory
tasks.work_avoided: Use newly located source instead of more command-register disassembly.
tasks.reuse: BSD-option exact vendor wave6_regdefine.h; GPL lifecycle as reference.
tasks.first_proof: Pinned symbol/register inventory agrees with wake/sleep constants and separates undocumented command-bank fields.
tasks.limits: Hardware submission, firmware lifecycle and VideoToolbox absent.

tasks.title: Prepare a U100/UCI host decoder
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid inventing link framing and protocol enums.
tasks.reuse: Exact U100 GPL reference + Apache AOSP UCI schemas/parser/test blocks.
tasks.first_proof: Compare bounded native decoder with generated standard golden vectors; test HAL/internal-header distinction, alignment, truncation and fragments.
tasks.limits: No SPI/reset/radio action; Samsung vendor commands and live identity remain unknown.

tasks.title: Evaluate standalone AIR as an independent frontend
tasks.work_avoided: Save future metadata/intrinsic/canonicalization maintenance while retaining existing subset.
tasks.reuse: Pinned metal2vulkan-air; existing MIT frontend is baseline, not discarded.
tasks.first_proof: Owned single_add/buffer_add inputs produce agreeing bindings/order/refusals; malformed/poison/FP-mode inputs stay explicit.
tasks.limits: Copyleft boundary and Rust 1.98 unresolved for runtime; no DXT emission supplied.

tasks.title: Tighten ECM control and transfer conformance
tasks.work_avoided: Reuse independent class rules without a new USB controller owner.
tasks.reuse: MIT TinyUSB/Apache Zephyr request and ZLP logic.
tasks.first_proof: Actual-source tests preserve frame bytes, handle exact-maxpacket ZLP and reject unsupported/full-index control requests across reset.
tasks.limits: Bulk DMA, Mac binding and packets still need separate physical evidence.

tasks.title: Preserve QMP events in one harness
tasks.work_avoided: Replace copied monitor clients that discard asynchronous events.
tasks.first_proof: Fake socket interleaves event/reply/error/EOF; all survive into bounded receipts and cleanup completes.
tasks.limits: Host dependency licence/version; no new VM manager or boot needed for proof.

tasks.title: Consume existing RTC, MotionProbe and BT capture work
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid repeating already delivered implementations and guest runs.
tasks.reuse: RTC0657, built MotionProbe, completed bt-3 capture.
tasks.local_seam: Current RTC path, RAM overlay app packaging, existing symbolication
tasks.first_proof: Rerun existing RTC checks; verify app packaging contracts; extract a bounded BT exit/load receipt with explicit loss/unknown-frame status.
tasks.limits: These are three owner-specific follow-ups, not one physical feature pass.

tasks.title: Differential-test ASTC before a texture import
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid decoder bitstream authoring and debugging.
tasks.reuse: Compact explicit-MIT decoder + Apache Arm decompressor oracle.
tasks.first_proof: Owned blocks/footprints, odd edges, alpha, sRGB policy, invalid blocks and guard bytes agree after explicit RGBA/BGRA normalization.
tasks.limits: Only if actual ASTC requests exist; no diagnosed icon cause.

tasks.title: Reuse a deterministic service-profile planner
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid manual disabled-job list comparison and rollback ownership mistakes.
tasks.reuse: MIT vphone select/reconcile/owned logic and host tests.
tasks.first_proof: Fixture dependency conflicts, unknown OS/groups, failed enable and rollback preserve unrelated labels/records.
tasks.limits: VM dependency findings are review inputs; no automatic mass-disable/enable policy.

tasks.title: Cross-check GPT/F2FS with external offline tools
tasks.work_avoided: Avoid a second handwritten metadata walker.
tasks.reuse: libfdisk read-only oracle, alias-aware f2fs-tools after readable metadata exists.
tasks.first_proof: Explicit4096-byte sectors, CRC/geometry/overlap/truncation comparisons and before/after image hashes; recovery-tolerant outputs stay distinct from strict acceptance.
tasks.limits: Encrypted metadata/alias state and complete captures unresolved; no writes/mounts/device paths.
